title: Grusch says he knows John Harrington

tellings.quote: I said, "Have you ever heard of John Harrington?" And Grush said, "Oh, I know I know John Harrington."

plain: In 2023, at his own house in Los Angeles, a Hollywood man named Bryce Zabel says he asked the whistleblower David Grusch, a former intelligence official, whether he had heard of John Harrington, the former US Secretary of Energy. Zabel tells Michels that Grusch answered, "Oh, I know I know John Harrington", which suggests the former secretary was already known to people inside the disclosure push.
